campaign.invariant_policy: Every active baseline invariant must be covered by at least one attack; I-MATURITY-01 is additionally exercised as candidate-boundary evidence.

novel_whitebox_probes: Semantic persisted-state corruption is replayed through verifyPersistedState and forged UTXO/mempool state must disappear.
Resource ceilings are checked at consensus, HTTP, secure-channel, peer-directory and PeerGuard boundaries.
Active core/browser source is checked for direct PQ/shadow/lab authority coupling.
PQ/MTS authority flags, release authority fences and cross-Lab ancestry semantics are checked together.
Supply-chain provenance remains source-bound and no scanner is allowed to become authority.

exit_binding.dedicated_psr15_workflow: required SUCCESS with zero OPEN_BLOCKER findings
exit_binding.codeql: signal only; may be SUCCESS but cannot waive campaign findings

downstream.no_findings_on_green: PSR-16 becomes READY as zero-finding closure verification / regression-promotion gate
downstream.findings_present: PSR-16 receives each OPEN_BLOCKER for fix/regression closure
